insurance_business_line.label: Insurance business line
insurance_business_line.value: Commercial and specialty property and casualty insurance, plus personal auto and homeowners insurance.

risk_underwriting_distribution_model.label: Risk underwriting / distribution model
risk_underwriting_distribution_model.value: Primary insurer offering commercial lines through select independent agents.

premium_exposure_mix.label: Premium / exposure mix
premium_exposure_mix.value: Commercial and specialty exposures include small and mid-sized businesses and professional liability, followed by personal auto and homeowners.

combined_ratio_p_c_underwriting.label: Combined ratio [P&C underwriting]
combined_ratio_p_c_underwriting.value: Calendar-year GAAP combined ratio on net earned premiums, with separate catastrophe-excluded and current accident-year catastrophe-excluded measures.

loss_lae_ratio_p_c_underwriting.label: Loss / LAE ratio [P&C underwriting]
loss_lae_ratio_p_c_underwriting.value: Net incurred losses and loss adjustment expenses divided by net earned premiums.

reinsurance_catastrophe_protection.label: Reinsurance / catastrophe protection
reinsurance_catastrophe_protection.value: Property catastrophe excess-of-loss reinsurance on a per-occurrence basis.

notes: The supplied lines do not establish investment-liability matching or a reported solvency measure.
